title: KFT shift report
description: Report published by the validator listing all EMV Known Fare Transactions (KFT) performed within an operator shift.

requestId.description: The traceId from the report request message that triggered this report.

shiftId.description: Identifier of the operator shift covered by this report.

readerId.description: Serial number of the EMV terminal (reader) attached to the validator.

status.description: Status of the report generation. 'success' means the report was generated and the listed transactions are complete; 'error' means generation failed and 'transactions' may be empty.

transactions.description: List of EMV KFT transactions performed within the shift.

datetime.description: Timestamp of the transaction (UTC, RFC3339 format).

rejectReason.description: Reason for rejection. Optional, as it may not always be available.

tapId.description: Unique identifier of the EMV tap event. Optional, as it may not always be available. Can only be cross-referenced against the EMV backend for taps that were synced to it; cancelled transactions are removed from the local sending queue and never reach the backend.

cardAid.description: Application Identifier (AID) of the EMV card.

value.description: Amount expressed in the smallest currency unit, scaled by exponent.

currencyCode.description: Numeric ISO 4217 currency code (e.g., 978 for EUR).

exponent.description: Number of decimal digits for the currency (e.g., 2 for cents).

eventTimestamp.description: Timestamp of when the report was produced (UTC, RFC3339 format).
